synopsis: The glossary and tools chapter consistently describe Fraunhofer ITWM Demify as research-and-service software for DEM-oriented soil–tool interaction in heavy machinery, rather than a complete collision-mitigation validation suite [f15987, f8592, f9140, f9141]. It is included among the tools with clear off-road and heavy-machinery relevance, with a focus on machine, terrain and granular-material physics [f16074, f8663, f9334]. Demify supports CPU/GPU execution and Python-oriented workflows, while its ecosystem is described as smaller than general commercial suites [f8592, f9143, f8593]. Sensor capabilities are listed as not applicable, and sensor simulation plus test management must be added; this aligns with the broader assessment that heavy-machine physics tools have thin sensor and scenario tooling [f9142, f8594, f8283]. Commercial licensing, public pricing and a numbered or latest release were not found, leaving procurement and version-planning gaps [f8595, f9144, f9145].
